# Balmond Objective Lock Draft

This draft is testing Balmond as an objective-lock answer rather than a flexible skirmish pick.

## What to watch

- Only trust the route if lanes reach pits on time.
- Track matchups where certainty is real, not imagined.
- Separate queue comfort from draft leverage.

## Draft focus

If the draft cannot guarantee territory, Balmond becomes honest but limited.

> Only publish the thesis if objective control is actually repeatable.

More on Balmond: keep this read connected to fighter jungle structures, not just isolated mechanics.
